data.acceptance:
1. Protocol-v2 manifests identify immutable generations, predecessor/control epochs, registered writer heads, snapshot hashes/counts, lossless pack hashes, and exact event-id/content-hash indexes.
2. Activation is immutable-object-first and exact expected-control-head CAS last; rollback publishes a higher recovery epoch that dominates acknowledged writer heads.
3. Legacy .knots/events, .knots/index, and .knots/snapshots are non-authoritative on v2 and cannot change canonical state.
4. No local or remote legacy path, archive ref, prior generation, pack, or Git object is deleted by this work.
